title: H6: RemoteChangeReconciler advances the history watermark before/regardless of work success

description: RemoteChangeReconciler.swift:124-135 - a reconcile that fails for any reason is lost PERMANENTLY, since the watermark has already moved past it. Contrast: LocalBackupCoordinator gets this right (advances only after successful apply) - the pattern to copy. Severity: High. Wave/Plan: Wave 4, plan 4a history-consumer-discipline (lands BEFORE 4b - never widen a mechanism that silently loses work). Sweep: stores/persistence. Class-killer: extract DrainGate (public), adopt in all remote-change consumers.
